styles.name: Bento Grid
styles.cues: 不同尺寸的模块共享列线和间距，卡片大小表达优先级
styles.use: 功能、数据或案例总览；移动端按阅读顺序排成单列
styles.cuesEn: Tiles of different sizes share a grid, with larger areas reserved for higher priorities.
styles.useEn: Feature, data, or case study overviews. Stack tiles in reading order on narrow screens.

styles.name: Swiss Design
styles.cues: 严格网格、无衬线字、左对齐、非对称但稳定的构图
styles.use: 文档、案例索引、需要快速扫读的产品页
styles.cuesEn: Strict alignment, sans serif type, and an asymmetrical composition anchored by a grid.
styles.useEn: Documentation, case indexes, and product pages designed for scanning.

styles.name: Editorial Design
styles.cues: 主标题、图注、正文列与全幅图交替，形成杂志式阅读节奏
styles.use: 作品集、长文、案例叙事
styles.cuesEn: Display titles, captions, text columns, and full-width imagery create a magazine-like rhythm.
styles.useEn: Portfolios, long reads, and visual case studies.

styles.name: Minimalism
styles.cues: 克制的元素数量、清楚的层级与有节奏的留白
styles.use: 专注于一个主要操作的首页或阅读界面
styles.cuesEn: Few elements, clear hierarchy, and deliberate whitespace.
styles.useEn: Focused landing pages and reading interfaces.

styles.name: Maximalism
styles.cues: 高密度图案、强色和多种尺度，仍有主次焦点
styles.use: 活动页、文化品牌、内容较少的宣传首屏
styles.cuesEn: Dense patterns, strong color, and several scales of detail share one clear point of focus.
styles.useEn: Events, cultural brands, and expressive campaign pages.

styles.name: Luxury Typography
styles.cues: 对比鲜明的展示字体、精细的字距和充足留白
styles.use: 精品品牌、项目标题、章节过渡；正文可用更易读的字体
styles.cuesEn: High contrast display type, precise spacing, and generous margins.
styles.useEn: Premium brands, project titles, and chapter openings. Pair with readable body type.

styles.name: Claymorphism
styles.cues: 饱满的圆角体积、柔光、内外阴影，像捏塑的物件
styles.use: 插画、吉祥物、引导页；适合局部主视觉
styles.cuesEn: Rounded volumes and soft inner and outer shadows resemble molded clay.
styles.useEn: Illustrations, mascots, and onboarding focal points.

styles.name: Glassmorphism
styles.cues: 半透明表面、背景模糊、薄描边；后方内容提供深度
styles.use: 首屏产品预览或浮层；确保不同背景下文字都清晰
styles.cuesEn: Translucent layers, thin edges, and blurred backgrounds create visible depth.
styles.useEn: Hero previews and overlays. Keep text readable against every background.

styles.name: Neumorphism
styles.cues: 近似同色的表面通过明暗双阴影显出凸起或凹陷
styles.use: 仪表和少量装饰控件；用轮廓或文字区分状态
styles.cuesEn: Paired shadows make controls appear raised or recessed into a nearly uniform surface.
styles.useEn: Dials and decorative controls. Use labels or outlines to distinguish states.

styles.name: Neo-Brutalism
styles.cues: 粗轮廓、硬阴影、高对比色块和直白标题
styles.use: 创作者工具、活动页、想让按钮和标签直接醒目的界面
styles.cuesEn: Heavy outlines, hard shadows, high-contrast blocks, and direct headlines.
styles.useEn: Creator tools, events, and prominent calls to action.

styles.name: Cybercore
styles.cues: 早期网络界面、故障纹理、数码符号与荧光色
styles.use: 数字文化项目、实验作品页
styles.cuesEn: Early web interfaces, glitches, digital symbols, and fluorescent color.
styles.useEn: Digital culture projects and experimental work.

styles.name: Cyberpunk
styles.cues: 暗色空间、霓虹、工业材质和未来城市的叙事感
styles.use: 游戏、科技品牌的首屏或概念展示
styles.cuesEn: Dark environments, neon accents, and industrial materials suggest a future city.
styles.useEn: Game sites, speculative products, and tech brand showcases.

styles.name: Y2K Aesthetic
styles.cues: 镀铬、半透明塑料、亮面和泡泡字
styles.use: 时尚企划、音乐活动、互动专题
styles.cuesEn: Chrome, translucent plastic, glossy surfaces, and bubble lettering.
styles.useEn: Fashion, music, and interactive features.

styles.name: Pixel Art
styles.cues: 明确的像素轮廓、有限色板与复古游戏图形
styles.use: 图标、角色、游戏化引导或插画
styles.cuesEn: Crisp pixel edges and limited palettes recall early game graphics.
styles.useEn: Icons, characters, and playful onboarding.

styles.name: Synthwave
styles.cues: 霓虹渐变、透视网格、日落剪影和八十年代科幻色调
styles.use: 音乐、夜间活动、复古科幻宣传
styles.cuesEn: Neon gradients, perspective grids, and sunset silhouettes evoke 1980s science fiction.
styles.useEn: Music, nightlife, and retro science-fiction campaigns.

styles.name: Scrapbook
styles.cues: 叠放照片、胶带、纸边与手写批注
styles.use: 个人作品集、活动记录、品牌故事
styles.cuesEn: Layered photos, tape, paper edges, and handwritten notes.
styles.useEn: Personal portfolios, event recaps, and brand stories.

styles.name: Surrealism
styles.cues: 不可能的空间、尺度错位、意外物件并置
styles.use: 概念首图、展览宣传；用一幅强图建立叙事
styles.cuesEn: Impossible spaces, unexpected pairings, and shifts in scale.
styles.useEn: Concept imagery, exhibitions, and a single striking campaign visual.

styles.name: Conceptual Sketch
styles.cues: 构造线、注记、手绘草图或分解示意
styles.use: 项目过程、功能解释、工程或设计作品集
styles.cuesEn: Construction lines, annotations, and exploded diagrams expose the thinking behind an object.
styles.useEn: Project processes, feature explanations, and engineering portfolios.

styles.name: Ethereal
styles.cues: 低饱和薄雾、轻透的光和宽松构图
styles.use: 美妆、艺术、冥想产品的主视觉
styles.cuesEn: Muted haze, luminous light, and airy compositions.
styles.useEn: Art, beauty, and meditation imagery.

styles.name: Bohemian
styles.cues: 手工图案、织物质地、温暖色调和有机形状
styles.use: 手作、旅行、生活方式品牌
styles.cuesEn: Handmade patterns, textile textures, warm colors, and organic shapes.
styles.useEn: Craft, travel, and lifestyle brands.

styles.name: Victorian
styles.cues: 装饰边框、繁复花纹、复古衬线字与雕版质感
styles.use: 历史专题、展览、复古品牌视觉
styles.cuesEn: Ornate borders, decorative patterns, serif type, and engraved details.
styles.useEn: History, exhibitions, and heritage brand identities.

styles.name: Wabi-Sabi
styles.cues: 自然材质、不规则边缘、克制的色彩与留白
styles.use: 建筑、手工艺、家具或强调材料的作品集
styles.cuesEn: Natural materials, irregular edges, muted colors, and open space.
styles.useEn: Architecture, craft, furniture, and material-led portfolios.

references.title: Process Bento
references.observe: 在深色网格中，用一张钴蓝色引导卡和若干步骤卡展开流程。
references.adapt: 让第一张卡解释流程的结果，后续卡片各讲一个阶段。卡片大小跟着内容优先级走。
references.tradeoff: 步骤有先后依赖时保留编号和阅读顺序，窄屏按顺序堆叠。
references.observeEn: A cobalt introduction and smaller step cards structure a process inside a dark grid.
references.adaptEn: Lead with the outcome. Give each stage its own tile, and size tiles by importance.
references.tradeoffEn: When steps depend on one another, preserve numbering and reading order as the grid stacks.

references.title: Headline Gallery
references.observe: 大号钴蓝标题的字间穿插倾斜照片，下方接一条缓慢移动的图像带。
references.adapt: 把照片当作标题中的停顿。用同一段标题文本保持连续阅读，把作品说明放进图注。
references.tradeoff: 手机上将图像移到标题下方，避免图片挤断词或改变句子的阅读顺序。
references.observeEn: Tilted photographs interrupt an oversized cobalt headline above a slow image ribbon.
references.adaptEn: Use images as pauses in a headline. Keep the title readable as one sentence and give the work captions.
references.tradeoffEn: Place images below the title on narrow screens so they do not break words or reading order.

references.title: Relay
references.observe: 黑底和青柠色贯穿整页，首屏倾斜的玻璃窗口中演示退款工作流。
references.adapt: 让玻璃层承载一个真实的产品流程，用同一个强调色把流程节点与后续区块连起来。
references.tradeoff: 将静态流程作为基础内容。低对比度背景和倾斜透视都可能让小字难读。
references.observeEn: A refund workflow plays inside a tilted glass window, with lime accents that continue across the page.
references.adaptEn: Put a real workflow inside the glass layer. Use one accent to connect product states to the rest of the page.
references.tradeoffEn: Provide a readable static workflow. Heavy perspective and low contrast can obscure small labels.

references.title: Bento Proof Grid
references.observe: 海军蓝网格并置亮黄色数字卡、图标卡和照片轮播。
references.adapt: 按证据的分量分配卡片尺寸。把最能支撑卖点的事实和它的上下文放进同一张卡。
references.tradeoff: 轮播如果隐藏关键证据，额外提供可直接看到的核心数据或文字。
references.observeEn: A navy grid mixes high-contrast statistics, icon cards, and a photo carousel.
references.adaptEn: Size each tile by the weight of its evidence. Pair the strongest claim with the context that makes it credible.
references.tradeoffEn: Keep the strongest proof visible even if supporting evidence lives inside a carousel.

references.title: Blueprint Tabs
references.observe: 切换功能标签时，蓝图重新绘制，并在旁边更新说明。
references.adapt: 复用同一张图的坐标和参照物，每个标签只强调一个变化，让解释能和图对上。
references.tradeoff: 关键变化要有文字。标签切换需要明确焦点和选中状态。
references.observeEn: Feature tabs redraw a blueprint and update the explanation beside it.
references.adaptEn: Keep the diagram in one place and highlight one change at a time as the explanation updates.
references.tradeoffEn: Describe key changes in text. Tabs need a clear focus indicator and selected state.

references.title: Kai Nomura
references.observe: 单色作品集用留白衬托随滚动出现的生成艺术作品。
references.adapt: 用紧凑的页头和固定的图注格式，把首屏和项目列表的主要面积留给作品。
references.tradeoff: 对不同长宽比的作品保留一致的图注锚点，并给滚动效果提供静态呈现。
references.observeEn: A monochrome portfolio uses open space to frame generative artwork revealed as you scroll.
references.adaptEn: Give the artwork most of the space. Keep the header compact and captions consistent across projects.
references.tradeoffEn: Anchor captions consistently across aspect ratios and provide a static alternative to scroll motion.

references.title: Artefakt
references.observe: 近黑色的网格会在指针下亮起，虹彩外套随滚动和指针变化，文字像从噪点中解码。
references.adapt: 让同一个商品贯穿页面，随内容推进切换观察角度。把网格和解码效果限制在展示区域。
references.tradeoff: 触屏和关闭动效时需要静态角度，价格、尺寸和操作一直保持可读。
references.observeEn: A near-black grid responds to the pointer while an iridescent jacket and decoded lettering carry the page.
references.adaptEn: Let one product carry the story. Change the crop or angle as the page moves from shape to material.
references.tradeoffEn: Provide a static view for touch and reduced motion. Keep price, size, and actions easy to read.

references.title: Refract
references.observe: 工具用条纹、磨砂等玻璃材质折射输入图像，可调效果。
references.adapt: 先用一张主图试折射，再把选定的材质应用到小块装饰背景或展示边缘。
references.tradeoff: 折射会干扰文字阅读。正文和按钮放在对比度稳定的表面上。
references.observeEn: The tool applies adjustable fluted or frosted glass refraction to an image.
references.adaptEn: Try refraction on one image, then apply it to a small decorative surface or the edge of a showcase.
references.tradeoffEn: Place text and actions on stable, high-contrast surfaces. Refraction can make copy hard to read.

references.title: Dither Art
references.observe: 在画布上组合有限色板、网点与终端感纹理，可以调整生成效果。
references.adapt: 给一张主图或过渡区添加有限色板的点阵。让点阵的尺度与页面中的图标尺度协调。
references.tradeoff: 控制纹理的覆盖面积和强度，小屏或低动效模式下优先用静帧。
references.observeEn: The canvas combines limited palettes, halftone patterns, and terminal-like textures.
references.adaptEn: Use a limited palette and visible dots on a single image or transition. Align the texture scale with your icons.
references.tradeoffEn: Keep the texture local. A still frame works well on small screens or with reduced motion.

references.title: Carbon 2x Grid
references.observe: 用同一基础单位安排列、盒子和边距，并为内容提供流式、固定和混合网格。
references.adapt: 让标题、卡片和图表对齐到同一组列线。按内容类型决定模块的尺寸随视口变化还是到点换列。
references.tradeoff: 列数和间距要跟着实际内容密度测，尤其检查宽表格和窄屏卡片。
references.observeEn: Columns, boxes, and margins share a base unit across fluid, fixed, and hybrid grids.
references.adaptEn: Align headlines, cards, and charts to the same columns. Decide which elements scale and which wrap.
references.tradeoffEn: Test column counts and spacing with real content, including wide tables and narrow cards.

references.title: GOV.UK Type scale
references.observe: 标题和正文共用一组字号与行高角色，并定义大小屏各自的排版比例。
references.adapt: 给标题、引言、正文和图注指定可复用的字号与行高。优先保住移动端正文的易读性。
references.tradeoff: 不同语言与字体的实际宽度有差异，用真实标题和正文验证行长与换行。
references.observeEn: Headings and body copy share a responsive set of sizes and line heights.
references.adaptEn: Assign reusable sizes and line heights to headlines, leads, body, and captions. Protect body readability on mobile.
references.tradeoffEn: Test line breaks with actual headlines in each language and font.

references.title: Reduced motion
references.observe: 通过系统的减少动态效果偏好切换界面动效。
references.adapt: 为滚动叙事、视差或自动播放准备能表达同样内容的静态版。保留必要的操作反馈。
references.tradeoff: 停掉装饰动画时也要检查内容是否完整显示，操作后的状态是否清楚。
references.observeEn: System motion preferences allow the interface to choose a calmer presentation.
references.adaptEn: Provide a still version of scroll stories, parallax, and autoplay while keeping essential feedback.
references.tradeoffEn: Confirm that all content remains visible and state changes stay clear when decorative motion is off.
